read.thesis: Q3 adjusted EPS $1.24 (+9.7%) with FPL capex ~$12B for 2026 and NEER backlog 36.7 GW; 2026 guidance $3.92–$4.02 held, targeting high end.

capex.quote: full-year capital investments are expected to be approximately $12 billion

triggers.label: Backlog 36.7 GW after 3.7 GW added
triggers.quote: adding 3.7 gigawatts of renewables and storage to its backlog, which now stands at approximately 36.7 gigawatts

triggers.label: 2026 EPS targeting high end
triggers.quote: continues to expect 2026 adjusted earnings per share to be in the range of $3.92 to $4.02 and is targeting the high end of that range

triggers.label: Regulated capital employed +9.2% YoY
triggers.quote: Regulatory capital employed increased by approximately 9.2%, compared to the prior-year comparable quarter.

guidance.quote: continues to expect 2026 adjusted earnings per share to be in the range of $3.92 to $4.02 and is targeting the high end of that range
expect a compound annual growth rate in adjusted earnings per share of 8%+ annually through 2032

red_flags.label: Pending Dominion merger; state approvals still open
red_flags.quote: The companies continue to expect the combination to close in the second half of 2027.
